mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_INQUIRY (USER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, BODY, PAGE, USER_AGENT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{body}, #{page}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_INQUIRY WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
mapper.sql: I.ID AS "id" ,I.CATEGORY AS "category" ,I.TITLE AS "title" ,I.BODY AS "body" ,I.STATUS AS "status" ,I.REPLY AS "reply" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.REPLIED_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "repliedAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_INQUIRY I WHERE I.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY I.ID DESC LIMIT 30
mapper.sql: ,I.USER_ID AS "userId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,I.PAGE AS "page" ,I.USER_AGENT AS "userAgent" ,I.AI_TYPE AS "aiType" ,I.AI_AREA AS "aiArea" ,I.AI_SEVERITY AS "aiSeverity" ,I.AI_SUMMARY AS "aiSummary" ,I.AI_FIX_HINT AS "aiFixHint" ,I.AI_REPLY AS "aiReply" ,I.AUTOFIX AS "autofix" ,I.RISK_FLAGS AS "riskFlags" ,I.TRIAGE_STATUS AS "triageStatus"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_INQUIRY I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.USER_ID WHERE I.ID = #{id}

SELECT ,(SELECT A.STATUS FROM T_AUTOFIX A WHERE A.INQUIRY_ID = I.ID ORDER BY A.ID DESC LIMIT 1) AS "autofixStatus" FROM T_INQUIRY I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY I.ID DESC LIMIT 100
